items.title: Send these readings to your care team today
items.text: Your blood sugar readings were higher than the target, with 28.9% of readings above 250 mg/dL. Contact your care team today to discuss your readings, which averaged 235.2 mg/dL.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You only walked after 2 of your scored meals, which is not enough to see the effect on your blood sugar. Walking after dinner was linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: All of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which was linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more than after earlier dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 9.8 hours, which is less than the 13 hours that might be beneficial. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone in the program.
